script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.organization_id,
       CAST(j.plant_id AS CHAR) AS plant_id,
       j.command,
       j.job_status,
       j.lease_owner,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live,
       j.row_version,
       j.attempt_count,
       j.idempotency_key,
       j.correlation_id,
       j.request_payload,
       j.is_deleted,
       (SELECT CAST(g.id AS CHAR) FROM goods_receiving g WHERE g.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND g.gr_v2_job_id = (CAST(j.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) AND g.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY g.id LIMIT 1) AS linked_gr,
       (SELECT g.gr_status FROM goods_receiving g WHERE g.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND g.gr_v2_job_id = (CAST(j.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) AND g.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY g.id LIMIT 1) AS linked_status
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_RPguard.data.jobId}}

script.code:
SELECT JSON_MERGE_PRESERVE(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(i.`id` AS CHAR), 'organization_id', i.`organization_id`, 'material_code', i.`material_code`, 'material_name', i.`material_name`,
		'material_desc', i.`material_desc`, 'based_uom', CAST(i.`based_uom` AS CHAR), 'material_costing_method', i.`material_costing_method`, 'purchase_unit_price', i.`purchase_unit_price`,
		'stock_control', i.`stock_control`, 'show_delivery', i.`show_delivery`, 'show_receiving', i.`show_receiving`, 'receiving_inspection', i.`receiving_inspection`,
		'item_batch_management', i.`item_batch_management`, 'serial_number_management', i.`serial_number_management`, 'batch_number_genaration', i.`batch_number_genaration`,
		'item_category', i.`item_category`, 'item_group_id', i.`item_group_id`, 'is_active', i.`is_active`, 'over_receive_tolerance', i.`over_receive_tolerance`), JSON_OBJECT('table_uom_conversion',
		COALESCE(
         (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(u.`id` AS CHAR), 'alt_uom_id', CAST(u.`alt_uom_id` AS CHAR), 'alt_qty', u.`alt_qty`, 'base_qty', u.`base_qty`,
		'base_uom_id', CAST(u.`base_uom_id` AS CHAR), 'over_receive_tolerance', u.`over_receive_tolerance`, 'over_delivery_tolerance', u.`over_delivery_tolerance`)) OVER (ORDER BY u.id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)
            FROM item_mji552rc_sub u WHERE u.Item_id = i.id AND u.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1), JSON_ARRAY()))) AS j
  FROM item i
 WHERE i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND i.is_deleted = 0
   AND i.id IN (SELECT l.item_id FROM goods_receiving_eg6l4ywi_sub l WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND l.goods_receiving_id = {{node:code_node_RPentry.data.grId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND l.item_id IS NOT NULL)
 ORDER BY i.id

		'category', s.`category`, 'show_hu', s.`show_hu`) AS j FROM putaway_setup s
 WHERE s.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_RPentry.data.organizationId}}' AND s.plant_id = (SELECT g.plant_id FROM goods_receiving g WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND g.id = {{node:code_node_RPentry.data.grId}})
UNION ALL
SELECT 'LB' AS k, sl.id AS sid, JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(sl.`id` AS CHAR), 'plant_id', CAST(sl.`plant_id` AS CHAR), 'organization_id', sl.`organization_id`, 'storage_location_code',
		sl.`storage_location_code`, 'location_type', sl.`location_type`, 'is_default', sl.`is_default`, 'storage_status', sl.`storage_status`, 'table_bin_location', sl.`table_bin_location`) AS j FROM storage_location sl
 WHERE sl.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND sl.is_deleted = 0 AND sl.storage_status = 1 AND sl.is_default = 1
   AND sl.location_type = 'Loading Bay' AND sl.plant_id = (SELECT g.plant_id FROM goods_receiving g WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_RPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND g.id = {{node:code_node_RPentry.data.grId}})
UNION ALL
SELECT 'TO' AS k, r.id AS sid, JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(r.id AS CHAR), 'business_type', r.business_type, 'is_default', r.is_default) AS j
  FROM su_code_serial_no_rule r WHERE r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.department_id = {{node:code_node_RPentry.data.organizationId}} AND r.business_type = 'Putaway' AND r.is_default = 1
